reviews.x: they are my favorite lashes i’ve gotten, fr! i’m 18 and into makeup and i can tell you, these are easy to put on, they are nice quality and they look real. i’ve gotten compliments saying people thought they were extensions! if you are having doubts about buying them, i can tell you, do it! you won’t be sorry

If your looking for a more natural look without the “dramatic” then these are great!! Very light on the eyes! The glue that comes with is not bad. Dries pretty fast and very sticky. Easy application! :)
I absolutely lovee these lashes , they are very soft and the glue is super strong . I got compliments from my peers and I recommended them to my friends . Definitely will order again !!
Great eyelashes for classy look. Not to dramatic and not too natural. The glue is also very good, reminds me of the KISS glue I usually use.

reviews.t: I’m in LOVE with these lashes!
reviews.x: I have absolutely fallen in love with these lashes. They are super for me to apply and the glue is amazing. I was expecting to use my other glue, but surprisingly the glue that came with the lashes was better than the name brand that I already owned. I am still fairly new to the lash game so I loved how thin and lightweight the band is. I certainly plan on making this my go-to brand and will order more soon.

These lashes are soft and fit most eye-sizes. However, the product description is totally off. I got the "natural" set and these are in no way "natural" even for falsies. It was very dramatic (and extra extra dramatic from the side view). I have used many different brands and sizes in the past and I think their 'natural' set should be relabeled as 'dramatic' or 'full'

These lashes are so pretty and not too natural looking!! Easy to apply and reuse without any residue build up. The glue dries clear and the tweezers are a pretty Rose gold. If you are looking for an every day lash without being too dramatic, but looking like you have a great mascara on you have found them!!

loved these lashes!! they’re super easy to apply (the glue works wonders!), and they give a really natural look while still having a bit of a dramatic effect :’) plus they have been lasting for a long time!! would definitely buy again and have been recommending them to others!
I'm on my last pair. And it's great. I am actually allergic to the black glue but the white glue works fine for me. I don't have to worry about it coming off. No skin burning or irritation.
There was a crap ton of rubber cement glue to adhere these to the plastic board. The band on these is really thick which makes them irritating to wear.
However I wasn't able to use them because the eyelash glue that came with them was dried out:/

reviews.t: The glue was completely dried upon receipt of the order~
reviews.x: I hate leaving negative reviews, but this item could use some improvements. First off, the glue was completely dried. Not one usable drop. Second, they are not very lightweight. Once you get them applied (they will need trimmed, width wise) they do look very nice! But they are heavy and require more glue than others just to keep them on. Perhaps that was because I was not using the glue that came with them? (Because I couldn't.) The tweezers are really nice though! Some of the best ones I have e

I loved these lashes! I’ve never worn lashes before in my life, and these were easy to put on, and I was able to wear them all day without them falling off- with the glue that was provided. So I didn’t feel like I had to waste my money on separate glue. They’re perfect for a natural look. I don’t like to go crazy with my makeup, but I still felt elegant at the same time.

I am a beginner at lashes and have yet to be able to get these to work. The adhesive just did not work for me and no matter what I do 5 minutes after application the lash is on my shirt. It is probably user error because as I said I am totally new to lashes so if you have experience it might work for you.

I thought these eyelashes were really great for the value.  There really  Thick and fluffy I think there really amazing and there my absolutely go to eyelashes for the day I recommend these eyelashes to everybody because you can't go wrong with these I give it a 5 star view absolutely 5 stars

My wife says these lashes are beautiful and very easy to apply. It comes with tweezers and a really strong glue that lasts a really long time. She says she find these lashes way easier to apply than the magnetic ones, and she'll definitely be wearing them on her birthday next week

I have used a lot of eyelashes in the past.. and let me just say that this is by the far the best set I have ever used! It also comes with a handy tool to help you get the eyelashes on properly, which is super helpful for my shaky hands. I definitely recommend!

These are very pretty lashes but the band is verrrry hard. The lash doesn't easily bend with the eye’s natural shape. This makes it difficult to apply the lash because as you place it along the lash line it’s trying to straighten back up to it’s original shape.

The lashes are very easy to apply for beginners. They look really pretty and fit most, if not all, eye shapes. The lash glue provides hold all day, even through my workouts. I love how lightweight they feel and can’t imagine trying any lashes other than these.

reviews.t: Good quality lashes for the price!
reviews.x: They were really easy to put on I've never used false lashes before and just bought these to see if I would like them and I love them! Good value for the money you pay for them.! If you're looking at them and wondering if you should buy them, you should!

I got this for my daughter she absolutely loves it. It’s not bad at all it sticks pretty good on her lashes and it’s very easy to adjusting it for a perfect fit. I do plan on buying more different style of lashes it is definitely worth to buy.

the glue takes a really long time to dry, the applicator was too thick and i couldn’t see what i was doing the lashes themselves were decent for a $9 product, i think the rim was a little too thick, making it harder for an easy application

reviews.t: Worked as claimed except they are cheap.
reviews.x: Very stiff not very flexible the tweezers and glue worked good they just are costumey but served there purpose and I did wear them all just to heavy and scratchy. Plastic basically but they never claimed to be different.

I loved this product. I tried them on with a makeup look yesterday and I love how natural they looked! I can reuse a pair 2-3 times. 10 bucks for 5 pairs of lashes?? You can not beat that! Will be purchasing again

They're great perfect for my wedding. Easy to use and place. Glue was my only issue but glue can be bought anywhere. Cant find nice eye lashes local unless you want big bushy gawky ones. Great price as well!

claims.text: Many reviewers find the lashes easy to apply and praise the included glue as strong and effective.
Reviewers frequently describe the lashes as soft, natural-looking, and good quality, often receiving compliments.
Several reviewers report the included glue arrived dried out or unusable.
Some reviewers note the lashes are heavier or thicker than expected, with one finding the band irritating.
A few reviewers say the product looks more dramatic than the description suggests.
